label: Music — Instrument Portrait
description: The instrument alone, treated as a portrait subject. Wear is the story: rosin dust, worn lacquer, dished frets, a chin rest polished pale. Lit like a product shot but graded like a portrait.
prefix: A still-life portrait of ({instrument}:1.35), alone and worth looking at.
suffix: Still-Life Rendering: (every mark of use held in focus — worn finish, dust, patina:1.3), (material honesty: lacquer, brass, rosewood, skin and gut read as themselves:1.25), controlled falloff into an unlit background, no human hands in frame.
negative: hands, people, clutter, watermark, text, logo
